name: telomerase RNA component

function.text: TERC encodes the RNA component of telomerase, providing the template used by the TERT catalytic subunit to add telomeric repeats to chromosome ends.

germline.text: Pathogenic constitutional TERC variants cause autosomal dominant telomere biology disorders, including dyskeratosis congenita. Marrow failure and myeloid malignancy risk occur within this inherited disease context; a tumor-only result does not establish constitutional origin.

somatic.text: Somatic copy-number gain involving the TERC region has been associated with progression of cervical neoplasia to invasive carcinoma. Regional gain is distinct from the constitutional loss-of-function mechanisms underlying telomere biology disorders.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Primary-study gene-level somatic/epigenetic context; alteration class explicitly stated in the paragraph.
